notes: EBIT is defined as GAAP 'Operating income' from IDEX consolidated statements of income. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

D&A is calculated as Depreciation plus Amortization of intangible assets from the cash flow statement (not a single combined line item). ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

NWC is defined as IDEX 'Operating working capital' = Receivables – net + Inventories – net – Trade accounts payable (i.e., excluding other current assets and other current liabilities). ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

WACC and terminal value inputs (terminal growth and EV/EBITDA multiple) are model assumptions rather than explicitly disclosed by the company; they are set to economically sensible values and adjusted in bull/bear.

NOL balance and utilization are set to null because the filing provides deferred tax assets on NOL carryforwards by jurisdiction, but not a single consolidated gross NOL amount suitable for direct insertion into the schema. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

Minority interest (noncontrolling interest) is reported as negative in the balance sheet; the schema requires absolute currency amounts, so the magnitude is used and the sign convention should be handled within the DCF implementation. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

catalysts: Execution against FY2026 organic sales and adjusted EPS guidance (1% to 2% organic sales; $8.15 to $8.35 adjusted EPS). ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Sustained order strength in HST tied to AI/data center power and semiconductor-related projects. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Ongoing free-cash-flow conversion enabling continued share repurchases (capital return is explicitly highlighted in results). ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
company_overview: IDEX is a diversified industrial manufacturer operating through three reporting segments: HST, FMT, and FSDP. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

Business mix spans engineered fluidics/pumps/valves and specialty systems, serving customers across life sciences, semiconductor/industrial and other end markets. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

The company generates steady operating cash flow and funds ongoing capital spending and capital return programs (dividends and share repurchases). ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))
current_context: FY2025 reported net sales of $3.4575B (up 6% reported; ~1% organic) with operating cash flow of $680.4M and free cash flow of $616.8M. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

FY2026 outlook: management projected full-year organic sales growth of 1% to 2% and adjusted diluted EPS of $8.15 to $8.35. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Management highlighted order momentum in HST in the context of AI-related project demand (e.g., data center power solutions and semiconductor applications). ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base case assumes ~2% annual revenue growth, consistent with management’s organic sales outlook rather than aggressive growth assumptions. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

EBIT margin modeled to recover gradually toward low-21% by 2030, reflecting normalization after a 2025 margin dip and a continued margin-expansion focus. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

Operating cash conversion is supported in the model by scaling D&A, capex, and working-capital intensity from the last three years’ observed relationships. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

Terminal value framework uses a conservative terminal growth rate (2.0%) and an exit EV/EBITDA multiple anchored to the peer set used in comps. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fls/statistics/))
key_risks: End-market cyclicality (notably life sciences and semiconductor-linked demand) could pressure volumes and margins versus base-case assumptions. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/news/news-details/2026/IDEX-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Acquisitions/divestitures and integration timing may create working-capital volatility and distort comparability (impacts captured in historical cash flow dynamics). ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))

Higher-than-modeled financing costs and/or FX impacts could reduce net earnings throughput and increase the effective discount rate. ([investors.idexcorp.com](https://investors.idexcorp.com/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/IEX-2025-12-31-10K-Final.pdf))
